name: 講座説明のシート
prompt:
Make only a background correction to image2, the Japanese syllabus sheet. The small BLACK wedges outside the rounded TOP LEFT and TOP RIGHT corners must become pure WHITE #FFFFFF, continuous with the white sheet and canvas. The final image must have no black/gray/mint outside the rounded corners, no transparency, and no added outline/shadow.
Preserve ALL existing Japanese wording, glyphs, punctuation, line breaks, four sections, font sizes/weights, spacing and layout exactly. Keep the header title「シラバス」and slate close X, fine header divider and white content surface. Do not regenerate or rewrite any text. Image1 ORIGINAL remains primary for close glyph geometry and sheet anatomy; image3 is secondary native Japanese content/typography; image4 official white finish. Only remove the black exterior-corner artifacts, no other changes. High-resolution flat raster.
reviewNotes: Correction inspected: black corner artifacts removed to white; all four Japanese sections and 5/3/2/2 body lines retained, readable Regular body/Bold headings, slate source-style close glyph and header divider. Existing condensed Japanese adaptation preserved. Exact encoding/font metrics/native editing/close and scroll actions unproven; agent raster visual review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
